# DSP Mutual Fund

> DSP Mutual Fund is an Indian asset management company managed by DSP Asset Managers Private Limited (DSPAM), headquartered in Mumbai and regulated by SEBI (SEBI Registration No. MF/036/97/7). It offers 75+ mutual fund schemes and ETFs across equity, debt, hybrid, index, ETF, fund of funds and solution-oriented categories, serving 63 lakh+ unique investors through 88,000+ distributors and offices in 40+ cities.

DSP Mutual Fund draws on the DSP Group's 160+ year legacy in Indian financial markets and nearly three decades in Indian asset management. It was originally formed as DSP Merrill Lynch Asset Management, a joint venture with Merrill Lynch. After BlackRock acquired Merrill Lynch's asset management business, it became DSP BlackRock Investment Managers. In 2018, the DSP Group bought back BlackRock's 40% stake and the business was renamed DSP Mutual Fund, a fully Indian-owned fund house. In 2023, DSP Investment Managers Private Limited demerged its asset management business into DSP Asset Managers Private Limited (DSPAM). DSP is a signatory to the UN Principles for Responsible Investment (PRI) and holds ISO 27001 certification for information security.

Domestic AUM: ₹2,04,000 crore (as on 22 Sep 2025, per the DSP About Us page).

Values: Spirituality (leading from within), Integrity (always do what is right), Community (here to serve, not just to succeed), Innovation (improve, relentlessly), Tech-Forward (embrace the future).

Registered Office: DSP Asset Managers Private Limited, The Ruby, 25th Floor, 29, Senapati Bapat Marg, Dadar (West), Mumbai – 400028, India. Tel: 022-66578000. Toll-free: 1800-208-4499 / 1800-200-4499. International: 044-61360066. Service hours: Mon–Fri 9 AM–6 PM, Sat 9 AM–1 PM IST.
